name: gameforge-mcp-core

tools.name: analyze_game_prompt
tools.description: Converts a natural-language game description into a complete, validated GameSpecification IR with engine recommendations.

prompt.description: The natural language game idea or requirement description.

tools.name: generate_game_design_document
tools.description: Generates a comprehensive, industry-standard Markdown Game Design Document (GDD) from the project specification.

save_to_file.description: Whether to save GDD.md directly to workspace.

file_path.description: Relative file path to save GDD.

tools.name: generate_game_architecture
tools.description: Generates the technical software architecture plan, ECS/Node diagrams, networking topologies, and persistence flow.

save_to_file.description: Whether to save ARCHITECTURE.md to workspace.

file_path.description: Relative file path to save architecture document.

tools.name: create_game_project
tools.description: Initializes a new game project directory structure, config files, and engine scaffolding with state tracking.

prompt.description: Optional natural language prompt to initialize full specification.

dry_run.description: Simulate file generation without modifying disk.

preview.description: Return generated file previews and diffs.

tools.name: select_game_engine
tools.description: Evaluates project criteria (2D/3D, platform, graphics, networking) to recommend the optimal engine or applies an explicit developer override.

tools.name: get_engine_capabilities
tools.description: Discovers engine capabilities (2D, 3D, VR, target platforms, graphics tier, physics, networking, scripting) for Godot, Unity, and Unreal Engine.

tools.name: generate_game_system
tools.description: Generates a custom game subsystem module (e.g. weather, day_night, crafting, reputation, stamina, tech_tree).

system_name.description: Name of the custom system (e.g. Weather, Crafting, DayNight).

force.description: Overwrite existing system if already generated.

tools.name: generate_scene
tools.description: Generates an engine-native scene / level layout file with node/actor hierarchies and spawn points.

scene_name.description: Name of the scene (e.g. ArenaLevel, BossChamber, MainMenu).

tools.name: generate_level
tools.description: Assembles a playable game level with spawn points, navigation mesh, lighting, and enemy encounters.

tools.name: generate_environment
tools.description: Generates terrain, skybox, environmental hazards, lighting presets, and foliage distribution controller.

tools.name: generate_gameplay_logic
tools.description: Generates core gameplay loop manager, round state controller, scoring, and win/loss assertions.

tools.name: generate_character
tools.description: Generates a playable character or NPC mesh, controller script, and animation state transitions.

tools.name: generate_enemy
tools.description: Generates enemy entity with AI controller, aggro detection, attack loop, and loot drop tables.

tools.name: generate_npc
tools.description: Generates non-player character with dialogue triggers, idle behaviors, and quest associations.

tools.name: generate_weapon
tools.description: Generates weapon mechanics (hitscan, projectile, melee, recoil, reload, durability).

tools.name: generate_vehicle
tools.description: Generates vehicle physics controller, drivetrain/thrust simulation, seat hooks, and camera bindings.

tools.name: generate_item
tools.description: Generates item entity (consumable, equipment, material, key item) with stats and modifiers.

tools.name: generate_ui
tools.description: Generates HUD, pause menu, inventory screen, main menu, and settings UI with responsive canvas and data bindings.

tools.name: generate_animation
tools.description: Generates animation state machine, BlendTree, and animation event dispatcher.

tools.name: generate_audio_plan
tools.description: Generates audio manager, spatial audio buses, music cues, and sound effects triggers.

tools.name: generate_dialogue
tools.description: Generates branching dialogue tree runner, condition flags, and speaker attribution.

tools.name: generate_quest_system
tools.description: Generates quest manager, objective tracker, stages, prerequisites, and rewards dispatcher.

tools.name: generate_inventory_system
tools.description: Generates grid/slot-based inventory manager, equipment slots, weight calculation, and item transfer logic.

tools.name: generate_save_system
tools.description: Generates persistent save/load serializer (JSON/Binary), slot management, and checksum validation.

tools.name: generate_settings_system
tools.description: Generates graphics, audio, and gameplay settings manager with persistent runtime application.

tools.name: generate_input_system
tools.description: Generates action-mapped input configuration (keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch, XR controllers).

tools.name: generate_camera_system
tools.description: Generates camera rig (FPS, TPS with collision avoidance, Top-Down, Isometric, 2D Follow with deadzone).

tools.name: generate_combat_system
tools.description: Generates damage calculation system, hitboxes, hurtboxes, status effects, combo counters.

tools.name: generate_ai_system
tools.description: Generates AI perception, Behavior Trees / Utility AI, Blackboard state, and threat tables.

tools.name: generate_navigation_system
tools.description: Generates NavMesh / navigation grid setup, pathfinding controller, and dynamic obstacle avoidance.

tools.name: generate_multiplayer_system
tools.description: Generates client-server / P2P network sync, state interpolation, RPCs, and lobby management.

tools.name: run_game
tools.description: Launches the multi-engine game runtime supervisor with live telemetry and log streaming.

tools.name: test_game
tools.description: Executes automated end-to-end AI gameplay test scenarios against the running game.

tools.name: inspect_game_errors
tools.description: Analyzes engine logs, compile errors, missing references, and script exceptions.

log_content.description: Raw log content. If omitted, checks existing log files.

tools.name: fix_game_errors
tools.description: Automatically applies fixes, patches scripts, resolves missing references or broken variable declarations.

tools.name: optimize_game
tools.description: Optimizes project assets, LODs, textures, and shaders according to platform profile budgets (PC, Mobile, Web, VR, Console).

tools.name: build_game
tools.description: Runs the 7-stage pre-flight validation pipeline and exports executable binary.

tools.name: export_game
tools.description: Packages build artifacts into distributable archives with SHA256 checksums and release audit report.

tools.name: package_game
tools.description: Bundles exported game directory or project workspace into a release archive (ZIP/Installer/Package).

tools.name: generate_project_report
tools.description: Generates an executive project summary, asset inventory scorecard, and dependency graph status.

tools.name: create_game_from_prompt
tools.description: Master one-shot autonomous orchestrator transforming a single natural language game prompt into a complete playable multi-engine game project.

prompt.description: Natural language description of the game to create

tools.name: continue_game
tools.description: Resumes work on an existing game project or adds new features without breaking existing assets.

instruction.description: Feature to add or next milestone to develop

tools.name: modify_game
tools.description: Applies global coherent modifications across lighting, atmosphere, materials, or gameplay mechanics (e.g. "Make the game darker").

tools.name: generate_asset
tools.description: Generates a 3D model, 2D sprite, texture, material, or audio stream and registers it in project memory.

tools.name: modify_asset
tools.description: Mutates an existing asset in-place (scale, textures, collision) preventing redundant duplicate generation (e.g. "Make the dragon bigger").

tools.name: generate_world
tools.description: Generates procedural terrain heightmaps, biomes, urban cities, dungeons, and road networks.

tools.name: generate_gameplay
tools.description: Generates core gameplay systems (inventory, combat, interaction, quest tracking, save/load).

tools.name: generate_ai
tools.description: Generates AI State Machines, Behavior Trees, perception cones, and navigation logic for enemies/NPCs.

tools.name: fix_game
tools.description: Automatically detects runtime bugs/compiler errors, applies safe repairs, and re-verifies stability.
